who was the author of the 1954 novel, \": William Golding published Lord of the Flies in 1954, about a group of schoolboys stranded on an island who descend into savagery. Golding won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1983.

what was the first ever entry written fo: SCP-173, the statue that moves when you are not looking at it, was the first SCP Foundation entry, posted online in 2007. The project is a collaborative fiction wiki about anomalous objects and creatures.
what was sir handel's original name in \: Sir Handel, a grumpy narrow-gauge engine on the Skarloey Railway, was originally called Falcon before being renamed. He appears in the Rev. W. Awdry's Railway Series, which inspired Thomas & Friends.
what's the second book in george r. r. m: A Clash of Kings, published in 1998, is the second book in George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire, after A Game of Thrones in 1996. The HBO series Game of Thrones is based on the series.
this play is generally considered to be: Romeo and Juliet, written in the mid-1590s, is probably Shakespeare's most adapted play, from ballet to West Side Story. The phrase "star-crossed lovers" comes from its prologue.
who wrote \"a tale of two cities\"?: Charles Dickens published A Tale of Two Cities in 1859, set in London and Paris around the French Revolution. It is one of the best-selling novels of all time.
who wrote the young adult novel \"the fa: John Green wrote The Fault in Our Stars, published in 2012. It follows two teenagers, Hazel and Augustus, who meet in a cancer support group, and it became a hit film in 2014.
who wrote \"the scarlet letter\", publis: Nathaniel Hawthorne published The Scarlet Letter in 1850, a story set in Puritan Boston about Hester Prynne, who is punished with a scarlet "A". It is considered a classic of American literature.
who wrote the novel 'fear and loathing i: Hunter S. Thompson wrote Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas, which first appeared in Rolling Stone in 1971 and became a book. It's a wild, semi-autobiographical road trip and a landmark of "gonzo journalism".
what is the title of the first sherlock: A Study in Scarlet, published in 1887, was Arthur Conan Doyle's first Sherlock Holmes story and the first time Holmes met Dr. Watson. Doyle went on to write four novels and 56 short stories about the detective.
which is not a book in the harry potter: The House Elf is not a Harry Potter book, although house elves like Dobby and Kreacher do appear in the series. The real titles are the seven books, such as Philosopher's Stone and Goblet of Fire.

which novel by john grisham was conceive: John Grisham's Camino Island (2017) is a heist novel about the theft of F. Scott Fitzgerald's manuscripts from Princeton's library. It is set on a Florida island.
what book series published by jim butche: The Dresden Files, by Jim Butcher, follows Harry Dresden, a professional wizard and private investigator in modern Chicago. The series began with Storm Front in 2000.

george orwell's novel \"animal farm\" wa: George Orwell's Animal Farm (1945) is an allegory of the Russian Revolution and the rise of Stalin's Soviet Union. The animals' revolt against the farmer mirrors how a revolution can turn into a dictatorship.
in michael crichton's novel \"jurassic p: In Michael Crichton's novel, John Hammond is killed by a pack of small Procompsognathus, or "Procompys", after a fall. In the movie, however, Hammond survives.
what is the name of eragon's dragon in \: Saphira is the blue dragon in Christopher Paolini's Eragon (2002). Paolini began writing the book at age 15 and his parents first published it themselves.

who is the author of the following short: Bret Harte wrote stories of the California Gold Rush, including "The Outcasts of Poker Flat" and "Tennessee's Partner". They helped define the American Western genre.

which of these does charlie not read in: The Perks of Being a Wallflower, by Stephen Chbosky (1999), is told through letters from a shy teenager named Charlie. His English teacher gives him books to read throughout the story.
in the magic: the gathering universe, wh: The Homelands expansion of Magic: The Gathering is set on the plane of Ulgrotha. It came out in 1995 and was known for its odd cards and unusual story.
in margaret atwood's \"the handmaid's ta: In Margaret Atwood's The Handmaid's Tale (1985), the narrator is called Offred, and hints in the text suggest her real name is June. The TV adaptation makes this explicit.
